title: Reference Manual of MEDiml
abstract: arXiv:2610.29666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radiomics is the high-throughput extraction of quantitative features (e.g., tumor shape, intensity distributions, and texture) from medical images to characterize tissues and uncover disease patterns invisible to the human eye. These features can serve as candidate imaging biomarkers for cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and classification. However, extracting thousands of features makes it difficult to identify the most informative ones for a given clinical task, while implementing an end-to-end workflow can require programming expertise that limits accessibility for clinical researchers. Hence, we propose MEDiml, an open-source, standards-compliant radiomics platform connecting feature extraction, predictive modeling, and interpretation through complementary graphical and programmatic interfaces. translated_abstract: 影像组学是从医学图像中高通量提取定量特征（例如肿瘤形状、强度分布和纹理），以表征组织并发现人眼无法察觉的疾病模式。这些特征可以作为癌症诊断、预后和分类的候选影像生物标志物。然而，提取数千个特征使得针对特定临床任务识别最具信息量的特征变得困难，而构建端到端的工作流程又往往需要编程专业知识，这限制了临床研究人员的使用可及性。因此，我们提出了MEDiml，一个开源、符合标准的影像组学平台，通过互补的图形界面和编程接口将特征提取、预测建模和结果解释连接起来。MEDiml将Python包（MEDiml-pkg）与图形桌面应用程序（MEDiml-app）相结合，使研究人员能够开展实验……
tldr: MEDiml是一个开源且符合标准的影像组学平台，通过结合Python包和图形桌面应用程序，以互补的图形与编程接口打通特征提取、预测建模和结果解释的端到端流程，降低了临床研究人员使用影像组学的门槛。
en_tdlr: MEDiml is an open-source, standards-compliant radiomics platform that combines a Python package with a graphical desktop application, connecting feature extraction, predictive modeling, and interpretation through complementary graphical and programmatic interfaces to make radiomics workflows more accessible to clinical researchers.
